## v2.12.52 - 2026-06-16
### Hotfix schema SQL contabilitate
- Pregatirea schemei SQL repara explicit tabelele contabile lipsa, chiar daca migrarile vechi apar deja in schema_migrations.
- Ruleaza idempotent migrarile 027_accounting_core si 028_accounting_controlling_link cand lipsesc tabelele necesare.
- Pastreaza app_state ca sursa principala pana la migrarea controlata pe module.
